CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  publication_year AS year,
  COUNT(*) AS total_reserved_materials,
  AVG(LENGTH(COALESCE(title, ''))) AS avg_title_length,
  COUNT(DISTINCT status) AS distinct_status_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) AS course_count
